note: Both sets contain heavy duplication and repeat the same misread that 48.9 °C is the half-points threshold (it is 46.1 °C / 115 °F), and both truncate the half-points quote so it reads as 'points are earned'. Set A additionally captures correct, distinct facts the page supports: the 120 °F / 48.9 °C full-points threshold, the heated-drying option must be disabled, and the allowed active/passive drying methods. Set B adds two clear errors absent from A: it reads the chart's x-axis tick values (90/100/110/120) as 'points' for the scoring function, and it invents an 8-hour clothes-drying cycle duration that appears nowhere on the page, plus a garbled 'eight place settings place settings' value. Overall A is more faithful and adds more correct coverage.
